newsitem.title: USA: Fed stays out of open market, action expected Wed.
newsitem.headline: Fed stays out of open market, action expected Wed.

text.p: The Federal Reserve stayed out of the open market on Tuesday, but analysts expect the Fed to add reserves on Wednesday.
Federal funds were trading at their 5-1/4 percent target rate at the Fed's usual 1130 EST/1530 GMT intervention time -- the same level at which funds opened.

Analysts contend that Monday's operation of four-day fixed system repurchase agreements took care of the day's add need. But, with a $3.5 billion to $4 billion average daily add need in the current two-week reserve period, further Fed action is expected this week, possibly as early as Wednesday.
